test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a rabi crop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gram commonly known as chickpea or Bengal gram is the most important pulse crop in India**. 
 
• The chickpea is an early legume of the family **Fabaceae, subfamily** Its different types are variously known as **gram or Bengal gram, garbanzo or garbanzo bean, or Egyptian pea**.
 
• Chickpea seeds are** high in protein.​**
 
• Barley, gram, and wheat are types of **Rabi crops.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Groundnut** is **a legume crop grown commonly for its edible seeds**. 
 
• It is generally grown in the tropics and subtropics, being crucial to both** small and large commercial producers.**
 
• **Maize **is **the world's leading crop and is generally cultivated as cereal grain that was domesticated in Central America.**
 
• Paddy **small, level, flooded field utilized to cultivate rice in southern and eastern Asia**. 
 
• A paddy field is a **flooded field of arable land **utilized for growing semiaquatic crops, most notably** rice and taro.**
